title: Autumn Journaling Cards Printable, 62 Fall Junk Journal Cards, Lined Journal Cards, Vintage Botanical Pocket Cards, ATC Size
description:
Looking for cozy journaling cards to tuck into pockets and write your autumn memories on? This set gives you 62 journaling cards and 4 matching lined pages.

WHO IT'S FOR
Junk journalers, memory keepers and pocket scrapbookers who love vintage botanicals and fall colors.

WHAT YOU GET: 14 printable pages in US Letter and A4
1. 54 journaling cards, 2.5 x 3.5 in (ATC size): 27 illustrated with a title, 27 lined for writing
2. 8 lined journaling cards, 3 x 4 in
3. 4 full-page lined journaling pages
4. 2 START HERE pages with printing tips

You receive 2 PDF files: one in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and one in A4, high resolution.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- 24 different titles such as Autumn Notes, Harvest Moon, Field Notes and Little Things
- Cards print at their true size on both paper sizes
- Each card has a framed writing area and a matching vintage paper background

HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files from the Purchases section of your Etsy account (use a web browser; the Etsy app does not download digital files)
2. Open the PDF that matches your paper: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) or A4
3. Print at 100% / Actual size on matte paper or light cardstock
4. Cut, fold, layer and create

GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a digital download: nothing is shipped
- Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers
- Personal use and physical handmade items you sell (journals, cards, scrapbooks) are welcome; reselling or sharing the digital files is not
- Some of the artwork was created with the help of AI tools, then selected and finished by hand
- Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is wrong with your files, message me and I'll make it right!

Part of the Ember & Oak autumn collection by Oakfold. Every piece is designed to match.
